footnotes: Abbreviation: PEN: penicillin, AMP, ampicillin, AMK: amikacin, CEF: cefpodxime, CLIN: clindamycin, GEN:gentamycin, CHL: chloramphenicol, ENR: enrofloxacin, MARB: marbofloxacin, ERM: erythromycin, BAC: bacitracin, NEO: neomycin, TOB: tobramycin, CIP: ciprofloxacin, OXY: Oxytetracyclin, TMP-SMX: trimethoprime sulphamethoxazole.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: Minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) of peptides against methicillin resistant Staphylococcus pseudintermedius (MRSP) strains.
footnotes: Abbreviation:OXA: oxacillin, AMK: amikacin, CEF: cefpodxime, CLIN: clindamycin, GEN: gentamycin, CHL: chloramphenicol, ENR: enrofloxacin, MARB: marbofloxacin, ERM: erythromycin, BAC: bacitracin, NEO: neomycin, TOB: tobramycin, CIP: ciprofloxacin, OXY: Oxytetracyclin, TMP-SMX: trimethoprime sulphamethoxazole, TIC: ticarcillin, IMI: imipenem.

tables.label: Table 4
tables.caption: The values of FIC index for the combination of peptides and antimicrobial compounds against Staphylococcus pseudintermedius (SP3).
footnotes: The FIC index was determined in the presence of a constant amount of peptide, equal to one -quarter of the peptide MIC.

tables.label: Table 5
tables.caption: Cytotoxicity and therapeutic index of peptides.
footnotes: GM, geometric mean of the MICs of the peptides against S. pseudintermedius strains.
IC50 (Inhibitory Concentration 50), peptide concentration that inhibits 50% of macrophage cell line (J774A.1) or human keratinocyte (HaCat).
TI (Therapeutic index), the ratio of the IC50 over the geometric mean MIC value.
